{"consolidated_memory":"**ml/features/encoder.py - NaN Feature Issues (Two Separate Incidents)**

Stack: Python
Test coverage: tests/ml/test_encoder.py
File affected: ml/features/encoder.py (ml pipeline side)

**INCIDENT 1: [2026-04-03]**
- Signal: NaN (not-a-number) value in one output column
- Manifestation: Only occurred for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- Reproduction: encode the batch holding the sparse column
- Root cause: Off-by-one error in the slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the slice bound and added a property test around it
- PR #5410, branch fix/nan-feature-1
- Outcome: 36 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

**INCIDENT 2: [2026-05-25]**
- Signal: NaN (not-a-number) value in one output column
- Manifestation: Only occurred for records carrying non-ASCII names
- Reproduction: encode the batch holding the sparse column
- Root cause: Connection pool exhaustion under burst load
- Fix: Raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
- PR #6545, branch fix/nan-feature-2
- Outcome: p99 latency improved from 8.4 s to 948 ms"}
